concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-sales-and-payouts-dashboard]] — 2026-09-15 merchant-account Sales to payouts dashboard guide: Sales includes pending and settled statuses, Payouts uses settled/refunded statuses, with batch charts and bank-tracing letter; dashboard state is not independent bank-credit proof.
warnings: The Sales and Payouts tabs define Sales using different status sets; preserve that distinction and the pending component in the Sales tab.
The page does not specify user-role eligibility, report currency, time zone or date-cutoff semantics; do not add them from adjacent guides or screenshots.
A payout-status label or bank instruction letter can help track a transfer, but does not independently prove merchant-bank credit.
